مقهى الواحة | المنيو الذكي
errors: Accessibility: 2 form fields missing id/name attribute

summary: 3 of 6 pages have console errors. Homepage reports 500 and 503 on some resources (likely external API or analytics scripts failing). /login has a 401 (likely an auth-check endpoint called before login). /menu/al-waha-cafe has a 404 resource load (possibly a missing image or API call) plus 2 a11y issues (form fields without id/name). The 404 page is well-implemented with clear messaging and navigation options. /pricing and /terms are clean — no console errors.
